model.description: The {@link ReliabilityMlModel} from the dataset of which, the training bounds will be derived.

features.description: The list of features for which the training bounds will be derived.

title:
Allows the construction and execution of queries to get feature training bounds for a given
{@link ReliabilityMlModel} for provided features.

The query will return the data of type {@link ReliabilitySensorTrainingBoundsQueryResult}.

Usage Example:
```
ReliabilitySensorTrainingBoundsQuery.make({
  model: 'ReliabilityMlModel',
  features: ['feature1', 'feature2']
}).execute({
  startTime: '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z',
  endTime: '2023-01-02T00:00:00Z',
  interval: 'QUARTER_HOUR',
})
```
name: ReliabilitySensorTrainingBoundsQuery
